# package logix

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-ethernetip/logix"
```

Package logix implements the Rockwell Automation Logix extensions of CIP: symbolic tag services (Read Tag, Write Tag, their fragmented forms, Read-Modify-Write), the tag list of the Symbol object, the Template object and the decoding of structures (UDTs).

These services are vendor specific: they are not part of CIP and EtherNet/IP devices in general do not implement them. [Client](#type-client) speaks to ControlLogix, CompactLogix and compatible controllers over any client.Doer (unconnected or Class 3); [TagServer](#type-tagserver) emulates a Logix tag database on a server.Server, for tests and simulators.

The behaviour follows the publicly documented Logix 5000 Controllers Data Access manual (1756-PM020) and what independent implementations (pycomm3, cpppo) accept.


The capacity and size of a Logix STRING.

```go
const StringHandle uint16 = 0x0FCE
```

StringHandle is the structure handle of the predefined Logix STRING structure: a DINT length and 82 SINT characters, 88 octets with padding.

```go

```

StructTypeCode is the type code that precedes a structure handle in tag services: 0x02A0.

## Types

### type Client

```go
type Client struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Client reads and writes the tags of a Logix controller over a client.Doer: a \*client.Client (unconnected, usually routed to the controller's slot with client.WithRoute) or a \*client.Conn (Class 3, as Logix tools use). It is safe for concurrent use.

#### func NewClient

```go
func NewClient(d client.Doer, opts ...ClientOption) *Client
```

NewClient returns a client of the controller d speaks to.

#### func (Client) DecodeStruct

```go
func (c *Client) DecodeStruct(ctx context.Context, id uint16, v Value) ([]Field, error)
```

DecodeStruct decodes the first element of a structure value, reading the templates of id and of its nested structures from the controller.

#### func (Client) ListTags

```go
func (c *Client) ListTags(ctx context.Context, program string) ([]Tag, error)
```

ListTags reads the tag list of the Symbol object with Get Instance Attribute List (0x55): controller-scoped tags when program is "", the tags of a program ("Program:Main") otherwise. System tags and the names of programs are included as the controller reports them. Like a fragmented read, the list stops with ethernetip.ErrProtocol beyond 16 MiB of replies or 65536 replies.

#### func (Client) ProgramName

```go
func (c *Client) ProgramName(ctx context.Context) (string, error)
```

ProgramName reads the controller's program (project) name from the Program Name object (0x64), as Logix programming tools show it.

#### func (Client) Read

```go
func (c *Client) Read(ctx context.Context, tag string, count int) (Value, error)
```

Read reads count elements of a tag (or of an element or member of one) with Read Tag, continuing with Read Tag Fragmented while the controller answers with partial transfers.

#### func (Client) ReadMany

```go
func (c *Client) ReadMany(ctx context.Context, tags []string) ([]Result, error)
```

ReadMany reads one element of each tag in one Multiple Service Packet (per batch that fits the client's maximum). Errors of single tags are in their Result; the returned error is for the exchange itself.

#### func (Client) Template

```go
func (c *Client) Template(ctx context.Context, id uint16) (*Template, error)
```

Template reads a structure template (Template object instance id): its attributes, then its definition with Read\_Template (at most 65536 replies, like a fragmented read). Templates are cached.

#### func (Client) Write

```go
func (c *Client) Write(ctx context.Context, tag string, v Value) error
```

Write writes v to a tag (or an element or member of one) with Write Tag, or Write Tag Fragmented when the data is larger than the client's maximum. The value's type must be the tag's.

#### func (Client) WriteBit

```go
func (c *Client) WriteBit(ctx context.Context, tag string, size int, set bool) error
```

WriteBit sets or clears one bit of an integer tag with Read-Modify-Write Tag; the name ends in the bit number ("Flags.3"). size is the integer's size in octets (1, 2, 4 or 8).

TagPath is a parsed tag name: its symbolic path and, when the name ends in a bit number ("Counts.5"), that bit.

#### func ParseTag

```go
func ParseTag(name string) (TagPath, error)
```

ParseTag parses a Logix tag name into its symbolic path:

	Tag                 a controller-scoped tag
	Program:Main.Tag    a program-scoped tag
	Tag[3]  Tag[1,2]    array elements (up to three dimensions)
	Tag.Member[2].Sub   structure members
	Tag.5               bit 5 of an integer

Each name becomes an ANSI extended symbol segment, each index a member segment.

### type TagServer

```go
type TagServer struct {

	// by lower-case full name

	// lower-case "program:x" -> instance

}
```

TagServer emulates the tag database of a Logix controller on a server.Server: symbolic and instance addressing of tags, Read Tag, Write Tag and their fragmented forms, Read-Modify-Write, the Symbol object's tag list, the Template object and the Program Name object. It is meant for tests and simulators, not as a controller.

A TagServer is safe for concurrent use.

#### func NewTagServer

```go
func NewTagServer(opts ...TagServerOption) *TagServer
```

NewTagServer returns an empty tag database.

#### func (TagServer) AddStructTag

```go
func (ts *TagServer) AddStructTag(name string, id uint16, dims ...int) error
```

AddStructTag adds a structure tag or array of template id; the STRING template (StringTemplate.ID) is predefined.

#### func (TagServer) AddTag

```go
func (ts *TagServer) AddTag(name string, t cip.DataType, dims ...int) error
```

AddTag adds an atomic tag (dims empty) or array (up to three dimensions). name may be program-scoped ("Program:Main.Speed"). Arrays of BOOL are stored as DWORDs, as in Logix.

#### func (TagServer) AddTemplate

```go
func (ts *TagServer) AddTemplate(t Template) error
```

AddTemplate adds a structure template. Its ID (1 to 0x0FFF) and handle must be unique, it has at most 65535 members (attribute 2 is 16 bits) and its members must fit its size.

#### func (TagServer) Attach

```go
func (ts *TagServer) Attach(s *server.Server)
```

Attach registers the emulation on a server: the symbol handler, the Symbol (0x6B), Template (0x6C) and Program Name (0x64) objects.

Get returns the whole value of a tag.

OnWrite sets a function called with the full name of a tag after an originator wrote it.

```go
	Name string

	Handle uint16

	Size    uint32

```

Template is a structure definition of the Template object.

#### func (Template) Decode

```go
func (t *Template) Decode(data []byte, lookup func(id uint16) *Template) ([]Field, error)
```

Decode decodes one element of the structure from data (at least Size octets). Members of structure type are decoded with lookup when it finds their template, and are otherwise left raw in Value. Hidden members are left out. The fields' data is one copy of data, shared by members that overlap: what a Decode allocates grows with data and the number of members, not with their product.

### type Value

```go
type Value struct {
	// Type is the atomic type; 0 for a structure.
	Type cip.DataType
	// Handle is the structure handle when Type is 0.
	Handle uint16
	// Count is the number of elements.
	Count int
	// Data holds the elements, little-endian, as the controller encodes
	// them.
	Data []byte
}
```

Value is the value of a tag or of part of one: Count elements of an atomic type, or of a structure identified by its handle.

#### func Floats

```go
func Floats(t cip.DataType, vs ...float64) (Value, error)
```

Floats returns a REAL or LREAL value with the elements vs. A finite value outside the REAL range fails rather than becoming an infinity; infinities and NaN are kept, and a value inside the range is rounded to the nearest REAL.

#### func Ints

```go
func Ints(t cip.DataType, vs ...int64) (Value, error)
```

Ints returns a value of integer type t with the elements vs; a value that does not fit t fails.

#### func Strings

```go
func Strings(vs ...string) (Value, error)
```

Strings returns a Logix STRING value with the texts vs; a text longer than 82 octets fails.

#### func Uints

```go
func Uints(t cip.DataType, vs ...uint64) (Value, error)
```

Uints returns a value of unsigned integer type t with the elements vs; a value that does not fit t fails. It is [Ints](#func-ints) for the values of ULINT and LWORD above the int64 range.
